blocking_findings.finding: The versioned XNYS calendar does not implement the actual regular-session set it claims to represent. It applies the generic Saturday-observed rule to next year's New Year's Day, incorrectly classifying Friday 2021-12-31 as closed and deriving 2021-12-30 as that month's cutoff. It also omits the known 2025-01-09 national day-of-mourning closure, classifies that date as open, and consequently derives 2025-01-31 as the 21st session after 2024-12-31 instead of 2025-02-03. These are direct violations of the canonical last-regular-session as_of and exact 21-session target contract.
evidence: core/forecast_contract.py:51 and core/forecast_contract.py:100-102 apply _observed() to next-year January 1 without the XNYS Saturday exception.
core/forecast_contract.py:81-86 contains exceptional closures only through 2018 and omits 2025-01-09.

blocking_findings.finding: ForecastContext.from_dict fails open on missing serialized contract fields. calendar_version and label are validated only when present, and analysis_mode is not required; removing analysis_mode, calendar_version, and label from a HISTORICAL_BACKTEST payload is accepted and silently restores it as LIVE. This loses the historical boundary and version identities rather than rejecting an incomplete payload, contrary to temporal-safety and reproducibility requirements.
evidence: core/forecast_contract.py:298-319 accepts a partial allowed-field mapping and invokes constructor defaults.
core/forecast_contract.py:307 and core/forecast_contract.py:313 make calendar/label checks conditional on presence.
Independent local round-trip mutation restored a HISTORICAL_BACKTEST payload with the three fields removed as analysis_mode=LIVE and accepted the missing calendar and label identities.

non_blocking_findings.finding: ForecastFeatureSlot.values is typed as dict[str, Any], so the type contract alone does not guarantee the draft/implementation claim that every new feature slot is compact and JSON-safe or exclude raw evidence/reasoning values. No Stage 01 persistence call site currently stores such payloads, so this is not the reason for rejection, but downstream producers must use compact JSON values/evidence IDs and add validation before persistence; narrowing the central alias in the retry would strengthen the contract.

QA's 10 AlphaEmbedder failures are retained as a visible downstream Stage 03 test-isolation issue: the legacy pipeline fixture uses sys.modules.setdefault and can reach the real HuggingFace loader when sentence_transformers was imported first and no local model is cached. Focused Stage 01 tests passed, the Primary full-unit run did not reproduce the extra 10, no RAG path changed in Stage 01, and zero external connections completed. This does not excuse the two Stage 01 contract defects above and must not be hidden in Stage 03.
